text:
Here is a comprehensive overview of the soft brand and collection options that hotel owners commonly consider globally when pursuing a hotel conversion:

---

## 🌐 Global Hotel Soft Brand & Collection Options for Conversion


The upper upscale and upscale conversion space is increasingly crowded, and the pitch to owners is essentially the same everywhere: keep your name, get our distribution.
 Below is a breakdown by major hospitality group:

---

### 🏨 Marriott International

Marriott played a pivotal role in expanding the soft brand hotel concept through its **Autograph Collection**, launched in 2010. Building on this success, Marriott expanded its offerings through the acquisition of Starwood Hotels and Resorts, adding other soft brands like **The Luxury Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, and **Design Hotels**.


- **Autograph Collection** – Upscale to upper-upscale independent hotels with a design and experiential focus.
- **Tribute Portfolio** – Boutique, character-driven independent hotels for spirited travelers.
- **The Luxury Collection** – Ultra-luxury, iconic destination properties.
- **Design Hotels** – Curated independently minded design-led properties.
- **Series by Marriott** – 
Announced in May 2025, **Series by Marriott** is Marriott's newest collection brand, designed to deliver a personalized experience that reflects the distinct character of each destination.


---

### 🏨 Hilton

Hilton's soft brand portfolio includes the **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, and **LXR Hotels & Resorts**.


- **Curio Collection** – Upper-upscale, one-of-a-kind independent hotels.
- **Tapestry Collection** – Upscale, independent properties with local personality.
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts** – Ultra-luxury, independent properties for discerning travelers.
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) Partnership** – 
Hilton announced a partnership with **Small Luxury Hotels of the World** in 2024. It's a classic quid pro quo: Hilton Honors members gain new options to earn and burn points; conversely, SLH gets exposure on Hilton booking channels.


---

### 🏨 IHG Hotels & Resorts

IHG offers the **Vignette Collection**, aimed at luxury independent hotels, and the midscale **Garner** brand, which is targeting an ambitious 1,000 properties over the next 20 years.


- **Vignette Collection** – Luxury and upper-upscale soft brand for distinctive independent hotels.
- **Garner Hotels** – 
Within two years of its August 2023 launch, the midscale conversion brand **Garner** surpassed 120 open and pipeline hotels. It has gained popularity with owners thanks to its competitive conversion cost per key, flexible design standards, and reduced pre-opening costs through a rapid conversion process.

- **voco Hotels** – 
A versatile and flexible brand aiming to reach 200 open or pipeline global properties by 2028.

- **Noted Collection** *(newest)* – IHG's latest soft brand targeting premium upscale conversions.

---

### 🏨 Hyatt Hotels Corporation

Hyatt has the **Unbound Collection** and **JdV by Hyatt**.


- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** – Upper-upscale to luxury, distinctive destination hotels.
- **JdV by Hyatt** – Upscale, independent lifestyle hotels with local character.
- **Mr & Mrs Smith Partnership** – 
Hyatt also expanded via its acquisition of **Mr & Mrs Smith**, a curated boutique hotel platform.


---

### 🏨 Accor

Accor has **Emblems**, **MGallery**, and the **Handwritten Collection** — showing all of the major players feel a need for soft brands at multiple price points.


- **Emblems Collection** – 
One of Accor's newest entries, **Emblems Collection** has established itself as a refined luxury soft brand, with 13 properties in the pipeline representing more than 1,000 rooms, and aims to reach 60 properties globally by 2032.

- **MGallery** – Upscale boutique collection with a story-driven concept.
- **Handwritten Collection** – 
Properties in the **Handwritten Collection** demonstrate how individual concepts can retain their unique identity while gaining brand support.


---

### 🏨 Wyndham Hotels & Resorts
- **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** – 
Wyndham offers the **Trademark Collection** as part of its soft brand portfolio for independent properties seeking chain affiliation.
 It targets upscale independent hotels seeking distribution support.

---

### 🏨 Choice Hotels International

Choice Hotels International's launch of the **Ascend Hotel Collection** in 2008 was the beginning of the race for soft brands.
 It remains one of the largest and most geographically diverse soft brand collections in the midscale/upper-midscale segment.

---

### 🏨 Best Western Hotels & Resorts

Best Western offers the **BW Premier Collection** and **BW Signature Collection** as its soft brand options for independent hotels.


---

### 🌐 Independent/Consortium Alternatives
- **Global Hotel Alliance (GHA)** – 
GHA brings together a collection of 50 independent hotel brands and nearly 1,000 properties worldwide
, offering an alternative to full chain affiliation.
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH)** – A well-known voluntary consortium for luxury independents, now boosted by its Hilton distribution partnership.

---

### 📊 Why Owners Are Choosing Conversions

Independent hotels face rising operational and compliance costs, while chain-affiliated properties benefit from distribution scale and brand systems — this is driving more conversions and the growth of soft brands and collections globally.



These collections retain a specific property name, as well as a unique design and orientation toward the local community
 — making them especially attractive to owners who want brand distribution power without surrendering the hotel's identity. 
The mechanism is simple: the hotel retains its own name but adds a subtle brand endorsement, while being fully integrated into the parent company's ecosystem — including the brand's PMS, revenue management algorithms, and procurement channels.

Here is a comprehensive overview of the soft brand and collection options that hotel owners commonly consider globally when pursuing a hotel conversion:

---

## 🌐 Global Hotel Soft Brand & Collection Options for Conversion


The upper upscale and upscale conversion space is increasingly crowded, and the pitch to owners is essentially the same everywhere: keep your name, get our distribution.
 Below is a breakdown by major hospitality group:

---

### 🏨 Marriott International

Marriott played a pivotal role in expanding the soft brand hotel concept through its **Autograph Collection**, launched in 2010. Building on this success, Marriott expanded its offerings through the acquisition of Starwood Hotels and Resorts, adding other soft brands like **The Luxury Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, and **Design Hotels**.


- **Autograph Collection** – Upscale to upper-upscale independent hotels with a design and experiential focus.
- **Tribute Portfolio** – Boutique, character-driven independent hotels for spirited travelers.
- **The Luxury Collection** – Ultra-luxury, iconic destination properties.
- **Design Hotels** – Curated independently minded design-led properties.
- **Series by Marriott** – 
Announced in May 2025, **Series by Marriott** is Marriott's newest collection brand, designed to deliver a personalized experience that reflects the distinct character of each destination.


---

### 🏨 Hilton

Hilton's soft brand portfolio includes the **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, and **LXR Hotels & Resorts**.


- **Curio Collection** – Upper-upscale, one-of-a-kind independent hotels.
- **Tapestry Collection** – Upscale, independent properties with local personality.
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts** – Ultra-luxury, independent properties for discerning travelers.
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) Partnership** – 
Hilton announced a partnership with **Small Luxury Hotels of the World** in 2024. It's a classic quid pro quo: Hilton Honors members gain new options to earn and burn points; conversely, SLH gets exposure on Hilton booking channels.


---

### 🏨 IHG Hotels & Resorts

IHG offers the **Vignette Collection**, aimed at luxury independent hotels, and the midscale **Garner** brand, which is targeting an ambitious 1,000 properties over the next 20 years.


- **Vignette Collection** – Luxury and upper-upscale soft brand for distinctive independent hotels.
- **Garner Hotels** – 
Within two years of its August 2023 launch, the midscale conversion brand **Garner** surpassed 120 open and pipeline hotels. It has gained popularity with owners thanks to its competitive conversion cost per key, flexible design standards, and reduced pre-opening costs through a rapid conversion process.

- **voco Hotels** – 
A versatile and flexible brand aiming to reach 200 open or pipeline global properties by 2028.

- **Noted Collection** *(newest)* – IHG's latest soft brand targeting premium upscale conversions.

---

### 🏨 Hyatt Hotels Corporation

Hyatt has the **Unbound Collection** and **JdV by Hyatt**.


- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** – Upper-upscale to luxury, distinctive destination hotels.
- **JdV by Hyatt** – Upscale, independent lifestyle hotels with local character.
- **Mr & Mrs Smith Partnership** – 
Hyatt also expanded via its acquisition of **Mr & Mrs Smith**, a curated boutique hotel platform.


---

### 🏨 Accor

Accor has **Emblems**, **MGallery**, and the **Handwritten Collection** — showing all of the major players feel a need for soft brands at multiple price points.


- **Emblems Collection** – 
One of Accor's newest entries, **Emblems Collection** has established itself as a refined luxury soft brand, with 13 properties in the pipeline representing more than 1,000 rooms, and aims to reach 60 properties globally by 2032.

- **MGallery** – Upscale boutique collection with a story-driven concept.
- **Handwritten Collection** – 
Properties in the **Handwritten Collection** demonstrate how individual concepts can retain their unique identity while gaining brand support.


---

### 🏨 Wyndham Hotels & Resorts
- **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** – 
Wyndham offers the **Trademark Collection** as part of its soft brand portfolio for independent properties seeking chain affiliation.
 It targets upscale independent hotels seeking distribution support.

---

### 🏨 Choice Hotels International

Choice Hotels International's launch of the **Ascend Hotel Collection** in 2008 was the beginning of the race for soft brands.
 It remains one of the largest and most geographically diverse soft brand collections in the midscale/upper-midscale segment.

---

### 🏨 Best Western Hotels & Resorts

Best Western offers the **BW Premier Collection** and **BW Signature Collection** as its soft brand options for independent hotels.


---

### 🌐 Independent/Consortium Alternatives
- **Global Hotel Alliance (GHA)** – 
GHA brings together a collection of 50 independent hotel brands and nearly 1,000 properties worldwide
, offering an alternative to full chain affiliation.
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH)** – A well-known voluntary consortium for luxury independents, now boosted by its Hilton distribution partnership.

---

### 📊 Why Owners Are Choosing Conversions

Independent hotels face rising operational and compliance costs, while chain-affiliated properties benefit from distribution scale and brand systems — this is driving more conversions and the growth of soft brands and collections globally.



These collections retain a specific property name, as well as a unique design and orientation toward the local community
 — making them especially attractive to owners who want brand distribution power without surrendering the hotel's identity. 
The mechanism is simple: the hotel retains its own name but adds a subtle brand endorsement, while being fully integrated into the parent company's ecosystem — including the brand's PMS, revenue management algorithms, and procurement channels.
